class.name: IfcMirroredProfileDef
class.brief_description: The IfcMirroredProfileDef defines the profile by mirroring the parent profile about the y axis of the parent profile coordinate system. That is, left and right of the parent profile are swapped. Notes: IfcMirroredProfileDef is primarily useful together with IfcCShapeProfileDef , IfcLShapeProfileDef , IfcUShapeProfileDef , or IfcZShapeProfileDef as parent profile but can be used with other parent p
